items.note: Open again. Commit 94ab20b5 reverted the loop-1 EDITOR.check override in controller.js. Replayed on this page: a missing semicolon at the end of line 3 shows "Ln 4 Not in this practice editor ... could not read the statement near select", and so does a misspelled keyword. On pages whose starter is only a comment, the untouched starter shows the same label ("Write at least one SQL statement, ending with a semicolon"). The limits list still defines the label as "not a sign that your SQL is wrong". The finding stands as originally written.

Resolved. The Problems marker still names the line after the mistake (a missing semicolon at the end of line 3 shows Ln 4), but the feedback now says "The editor names the line where it noticed the problem; a missing comma or semicolon is often at the end of the line before it". That meets policy 1.3's "says so and names the nearest place to look". Activity 3's missing semicolon before the trailing SELECT now gets that sentence.
Recounted the same way (prose of [data-pep-teaching], leaving out pre blocks and figures): Activity 2 is about 99 words and Activity 4 about 107, both within 120.
The Who points at whom caption now explains lead_id ("points at another instructor, the person's team lead.").
Replayed: a run with no INSERT now says "No INSERT into students ran yet. Write your INSERT ... SELECT on the empty line under the comment."
o3 now reads "Choose the psql \copy command to load rows from a CSV file and explain how it differs from server-side COPY", which matches the choice activity.
The correct option of "o3 which program reads it" is no longer the longest; the length check finds no cue in this bank.
Resolved. The In interviews row now ends "Activities 1 and 2 practise both".

Partly fixed. The bar now says "Practice editor: imitates PostgreSQL on this page's sample tables, without a real server". Output still opens "(lesson simulator, not real PostgreSQL server)", and after a run that stops with a PostgreSQL ERROR (column "nme" does not exist) the Problems tab still says "No problems found by the lesson checker". The editor still has three names (practice editor, lesson simulator, lesson checker), and the Problems tab and Output still disagree after an ERROR.

Resolved. Confidence reads Guessing / Fairly sure / Certain, and the calibration line echoes "Fairly sure". A wrong guess opens "Not this time; the right answer is marked." The end message reads "Activities 2, 3 and 4 are not done yet".
Resolved. At both 570 and 1280 px the page now loads with scrollY 0 and no hash (go(...) no longer writes the hash on first load), so the topic bar and Topic objectives are on the first screen.

At 94ab20b5 the caption clause "so within one INSERT a lead's row comes before the rows that point at it" is removed, both from the page and from page-build/src/seeding-sample-data.body.html. The caption now ends "the person's team lead." No wrong ordering rule remains.
